#ifndef AVCODEC_RISCV_H264PRED_H
#define AVCODEC_RISCV_H264PRED_H

#include "libavutil/attributes.h"

#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"

/*
 * Public prototypes for RISC-V H.264 prediction init.
 *
 * This header is included by the corresponding .c file to satisfy
 * -Wmissing-prototypes when building with -Werror.
 */
av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
                                    int bit_depth, const int chroma_format_idc);

/* RVV-specific initializer (may be compiled conditionally). */
av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv_rvv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
                                        int bit_depth, const int chroma_format_idc);

#endif /* AVCODEC_RISCV_H264PRED_H */

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/libavcodec/riscv/h264pred_init_riscv.c
@@
-#include "config.h"
-
-#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
-#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
-
-#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"
+#include "config.h"
+
+#include "libavutil/attributes.h"
+#include "libavutil/cpu.h"
+
+#include "libavcodec/h264pred.h"
+#include "libavcodec/riscv/h264pred.h"
+
+/*
+ * Some trees/versions may not expose AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV in libavutil/cpu.h.
+ * Provide a safe fallback so this file can compile across configurations.
+ */
+#ifndef AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV
+#define AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV 0
+#endif
@@
 av_cold void ff_h264_pred_init_riscv(H264PredContext *h, int codec_id,
                                     int bit_depth, const int chroma_format_idc)
 {
     int flags = av_get_cpu_flags();
 
     if (bit_depth == 8 && (flags & AV_CPU_FLAG_RVV)) {
         ff_h264_pred_init_riscv_rvv(h, codec_id, bit_depth, chroma_format_idc);
     }
 }
*** End Patch
